aboutGame.title: What Is Garfield: Escape from Monday?
paragraphs: Garfield: Escape from Monday is a 3D platform adventure developed by OSome Studio and published by Microids. Garfield is trapped inside the worst day of the week, and the only way out is to hop, dash, and puzzle through a nightmare version of Monday before the clock resets.

Across 40+ levels, Garfield swaps between special costumes such as the turkey, surfer, and cowboy forms, each with unique abilities for platforming sections. Collect lasagna tokens, comic panel cards, Monday clocks, and hidden charms for room customization rewards, then chase faster routes in Time Attack.

modules.name: Garfield Escape from Monday Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly guide covering the basic gameplay loop, movement controls, costume abilities, level progression, and first-time player tips.

highlights.detail: Read the screen and scan for ledges, hazards, and the exit before you move.
Open Settings and remap the controls if the default bindings feel awkward.
Play the first world slowly to learn layouts instead of chasing the timer.
Grab lasagna and pickups along your natural route, then bank them.
Replay your weakest stage each session to build muscle memory.
Move on to the next world once the fundamentals feel automatic.

items.question: What is Garfield: Escape from Monday Wiki?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday Wiki is a fan-built guide hub for the 3D platform adventure Garfield: Escape from Monday. It covers beginner tips, costumes, levels, collectibles, characters, bosses, achievements, and platform details.

items.question: Who developed Garfield: Escape from Monday?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday was developed by OSome Studio and published by Microids.

items.question: What platforms is Garfield: Escape from Monday on?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday is available on Windows PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

items.question: Does Garfield: Escape from Monday have codes?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday has no active redeem codes. Costumes, collectibles, and achievements are unlocked through normal play instead.

items.question: How many levels does Garfield: Escape from Monday have?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday offers 40+ levels spread across Garfield's nightmare worlds, plus Time Attack routes for players who want to shave seconds.

items.question: What costumes are in Garfield: Escape from Monday?
items.answer: Garfield: Escape from Monday includes special costumes such as the turkey, surfer, and cowboy forms, each with a unique ability used during platforming sections.
